info.title: ByKaranteli crypto derivatives data
info.description: Crypto derivatives market structure recorded around the clock. The live snapshots are free and unmetered; the endpoints listed here sell depth and history per call over the x402 protocol.
info.x-guidance: Free endpoints under /api/public/* need no payment or key. The /api/x402/* endpoints answer HTTP 402 with machine-readable payment requirements and settle in USDC on Solana or Base per successful response. A failed response settles nothing.

get.summary: List paid endpoints, prices and settlement rails
get.description: Machine-readable catalog of the paid endpoints: per-call price in USD, the accepted settlement networks and the pay-to addresses. No payment required.
